intro: Shows your local time and date on stream as a text line, a digital clock, or a round analog clock. The clock ticks by itself in OBS. No Streamer.bot import is needed.

sections.title: 1. Clock
sections.notice: Leave the time zone empty to use this PC's time.

sections.title: 2. Look
sections.notice: Add http://127.0.0.1:8787/overlay/addons/thsv.local-clock as a 1920x1080 browser source in the scenes where the clock should show, then crop or move it into place.

sections.title: 3. Chat command (optional)
sections.notice: Restart StreamBridge after changing the command.
